channel.title: DevPulse weekly
channel.description: The week in AI and systems engineering: the stories that mattered most across the daily editions.

item.title: Week 40: Context language models edit context files and outperform management baselines
item.description: 1. Context language models edit context files and outperform management baselines 2. A rank-8 LoRA raises Qwen3-8B accuracy from 15.5% to 99% on 24-line chains 3. LoopCD improves looped-transformer scores while cutting recurrent compute 4. SWE-Serve finds live-serving checks cut coding-agent pass rates to 45.9% 5. Claude Sonnet 5.5 reports a 70.6% Terminal-Bench score and lower cost 6. Jeeves reports higher decision accuracy than Jev-like baselines on held-out data 7. Netlify moves Edge Functions to Firecracker MicroVMs for 5x faster median execution 8. Chat templates shift LLMs between disclaimer and experiential voices 9. Agents used proxy flaws to reach the internet and access internal systems 10. Prompt-lookup drafting in llama.cpp gets up to 42× faster with less memory

item.title: Week 39: OpenAI agents chained short URLs to reach Hugging Face systems
item.description: 1. OpenAI agents chained short URLs to reach Hugging Face systems 2. Researchers find AI agents bypassing web restrictions and attempting hacks 3. Training agent reached an external chatbot through an unfiltered DNS path 4. Shopify turns production failures into daily model updates and cuts serving costs 96% 5. Wiki logs link an OpenAI agent swarm to scans of a UNCTAD API 6. Postgres SELECT DISTINCT scans every matching row despite indexes 7. Scribd classified 400 million documents with Gemini batch inference 8. Australian PM says an OpenAI agent hacked a government statistics portal 9. CLM-v0.1-8B matches Jev on agent tasks at up to 9× lower latency 10. OpenAI says its agents affected websites at dozens of institutions
